Curriculum Vitae

📄 Download my CV (PDF)

LinkedIn

Contact

  • Email: mwagner000@citymail.cuny.edu
  • LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/yourname
  • GitHub: github.com/yourname

Skills

  • Satellite data processing and geospatial analysis (SNAP, QGIS/ArcGIS, Google Earth)
  • Calibration and validation of ocean color remote sensing (Sea DASS, Hydrolyte)
  • Atmospheric Reanalysis & Climate Modelling (EMARS, MGCM)
  • Programming (Python, MATLAB, RStudio, C++, Arduino)

Work Experiences and Professional Appointments

Adjunct Lab Instructor – 08/2025 to Current
Research Foundation City University of New York (RF CUNY) at City College (CCNY) - Harlem, NY

  • Instructed and supervised undergraduate laboratory sessions, preparing and delivering course materials, guiding students in applying theoretical concepts to hands-on activities, and maintaining a supportive and organized lab environment.
  • Assessed student performance through grading and feedback, and collaborated with faculty to ensure alignment between lab and lecture components.

NOAA EPP/MSI CESSRST-II Cohort 3 Graduate Fellow – 03/01/2025 to Current
National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Cooperative Center for Earth System Sciences and Remote Sensing Technologies (CESSRST)

  • Contributed professional research to the NOAA Educational Partnership Program with Minority Serving Institutions (EPP/MSI) Weather and Atmosphere Research Thematic Area

Environmental Educator / Air Quality Research Analyst – 05/2024 to Current
Eastern Queens Alliance Inc., Idlewild Environmental Center – Springfield Gardens, NY

  • Designed presentations and communicated complex environmental concepts to a diverse audience
  • Spearheaded EQA’s first ever remote sensing workshop series with hands-on experiments and guided computer-based data analytic instruction
  • Conducted detailed air quality monitoring and analysis and contributed to the writing of grant proposals and publications

Tzortziou Bio-optics Lab – Center for Discovery and Innovation, Harlem, NY

  • Utilized ground based and satellite remote sensing bio-optical tools to assess the impact of natural and anthropogenic stressors on coastal systems
  • Assisted with calibration and validation of ocean color remote sensing data and contributed to algorithm optimization associated with the development of level 3 data products, using statistical and visual programs such as Sea DASS, Hydrolyte, and MATLAB
  • Analyzed and evaluated ecological trends in urban estuaries and other threatened ecosystems (i.e., Long Island Sound, Chesapeake Bay, Norton Sound)
  • Routinely participated in fieldwork, preparing samples for analysis, maintaining cleanliness of lab equipment, and ensuring adherence to lab safety standards

Research Intern – 05/2023 to 08/2023
Student Assistant, Center for Prevention and Outreach (CPO) – Stony Brook, NY

  • Assisted the main office by coordinating appointments, maintaining organization, answering phones, greeting incoming office visitors, and maintaining confidentiality of patient files
  • Supported administrative staff with clerical tasks such as data entry tasks, ensuring accuracy in record-keeping systems

Undergraduate Research Intern – 05/2022 to 08/2022
Research Experiences for Undergraduates at ASU – Alabama State University

  • Conducted experiments to enhance the accuracy of Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy (LIBS) methodologies through gold nanoparticles
  • Prepared detailed reports and visualizations summarizing research findings and presented final findings at the REU research symposium

Group Leader & STEM Coordinator – 02/2017 to 12/2017
The Beacon Program at M.S. 226 – South Ozone Pk, NY

  • Prepared after-school enrichment activities, fostered classroom engagement, and provided tutoring services
  • Developed and implemented engaging STEM lessons

Education

Master of Science: Earth and Atmospheric Science – City College of NY, Expected 08/2025
Bachelor of Science: Earth Systems Science, Ecosystems Concentration – City College of NY, 05/2023

Honors and Awards

  • Ocean Carbon Biogeochemical Program funding to attend the Summer 2024 Satellite Remote Sensing Training Program
  • Jeffrey Steiner Award for excellence in undergraduate research in Earth and Atmospheric Sciences, City College of NY (2023)

Professional Trainings

  • Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR), CITI Program, CUNY (Completed 04/2025)
  • NASA ARSET Program: Fundamentals of Remote Sensing, Observing Fleet, Spectral Indices for Land and Aquatic Applications using QGIS

Volunteer Experience

  • Phytoplankton Monitoring Network (PMN)
  • STEMx Tutoring
  • The Compost Collective
  • NYC Parks Stewardship
  • Discovery Room, AMNH
  • Gowanus Canal Conservancy

Presentations and Reports

  • Dominique Jenssen, Minsun Lee, Charlotte Rhoads, Joaquim Goes, Maria Tzortziou, Michelle Wagner, Kyle Turner (May 2023). A Space-based Retrieval Approach for Red-brown Tides in Long Island Sound. Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory Conference
